title: Fearlessness
painPoint: Fear of failure, rejection, judgment, public speaking, taking risks
summary: Fear is the root of misery; strength is life. Break out of the mental spotlight where everyone is watching you.

title: Self-Faith
painPoint: Self-doubt, insecurity, comparison, “I’m not good enough”
summary: All power is already within you. You cannot believe in anything outside until you believe in who you are.

title: Focus
painPoint: Distraction, overthinking, phone addiction, inability to concentrate
summary: Concentration is the real key to knowledge. The scattered mind flickers; the focused mind illuminates.

title: Purpose
painPoint: Feeling lost, confused about life/career, too many directions, lack of meaning
summary: Take one idea and make that idea your life. Live, breathe, and embody it instead of chasing ten half-dreams.

title: Persistence
painPoint: Failure, setbacks, wanting to quit, repeated rejection
summary: Rise after every fall. Even if you fail a thousand times, make another attempt until the goal is met.

title: Strength
painPoint: Burnout, feeling mentally weak, lack of resilience, difficult periods
summary: Muscles of iron, nerves of steel. Anything that makes you weak physically or mentally, reject as poison.

title: Self-Mastery
painPoint: Anger, impulses, bad habits, validation, jealousy, controlling reactions
summary: Conquer yourself, not others. True power is ruling your own reactions when social media feeds trigger envy.

title: Service
painPoint: Selfishness, lack of purpose, helping others, empathy, social responsibility
summary: They alone live, who live for others. Shift your axis from your own tiny ego to something larger than yourself.
